title: Users App Core Systems Completion Audit

A_authentication_account.notes: Firebase Auth (Email, Google via Credential Manager), guest mode, profile, account settings, security manager.

B_home.notes: TMDB feeds (Trending, Popular, Upcoming, New Releases), hero carousel, disk caching, continue watching.

C_search.notes: TMDB + extension search, canonical /config/search_order read-only consumption, debouncing, history.

D_details.notes: Movie, Series, Anime, Person details, episodes, seasons, backdrop, cast, trailers, action bar.

E_player.notes: ExoPlayer / Media3 HLS and MP4, YouTube player, WebView engine, quality selection, resume store, revalidation.

F_downloads.notes: UnifiedDownloadCoordinator, DownloaderHandoffAdapter, StreamDownloaderService, batch download, offline playback.

G_favorites_watchlist.notes: Room LibraryDao + Firestore /users/{uid}/library/{libraryId} sync, namespaced IDs, offline support.

H_history_continue_watching.notes: Room HistoryDao & WatchedEpisodeDao + Firestore sync (/users/{uid}/history and /watched_episodes).

I_extensions.notes: Managed extensions (/managed_extensions), legacy read fallback (/extensions), 5 scrapers (Qfilm, EgyDead, Anime4Up, AnimeBlkom, Witanime).

J_social_systems.notes: Firestore conversations & stories, Cloudinary media upload, user blocking. Background push alerts for incoming chat are BLOCKED BY BACKEND.

K_support.notes: /support_conversations/{uid}/messages/{msgId} user-admin realtime messaging, Room SupportDao caching.

L_reports.notes: Content and user reporting to /reports/{reportId} with duplicate prevention.

M_economy.notes: Temporary Firebase Economy mode. Wallet, ledger, daily login (10..50), rewarded ads (15pts), redemption (50, 250, 350, 1000). Trusted server authority BLOCKED BY BACKEND.

N_subscription.notes: REMOVE_ADS only invariant. Tiers FREE, PRO_LITE, PRO. Video quality and download resolution strictly decoupled.

O_notifications.notes: Firestore /notifications -> Room -> ViewModel -> UI, preferences at /users/{uid}/settings/notifications, FCM token sync. Server push BLOCKED BY BACKEND.

P_app_updates.notes: Canonical /app_updates + fallback /config/app, numeric versionCode comparison, mandatory & optional dialogs.

Q_settings.notes: Account, notification preferences, playback, language, theme, storage clear/export.

R_navigation.notes: Compose Navigation graph, BottomNavBar, BackHandler, transitions, deep link support.

S_offline_behavior.notes: Room database persistence, DataStore preferences, disk cached feeds and media details, offline downloads.

T_error_loading_empty_states.notes: Shimmer skeleton loaders, empty states in all lists, error retry triggers, CrashActivity.

U_firebase_inventory.notes: Complete inventory of 25 collection paths verified across Kotlin sources and Firestore rules.

V_firestore_rules.notes: firestore.rules audit confirms strict owner scoping, admin authority on config/catalog, zero wildcard writes.

W_code_quality_dead_features.notes: MediaActionBottomSheet has static sample stream list; HelpSupportScreen top bar has 1 empty TODO click handler.

X_build_and_tests.notes: All 51 test suites compile and execute with 650 passed tests and 0 failures.

backend_dependent_items: FCM Server-side background push delivery (requires FCM HTTP v1 API / Cloud Functions / Worker)
Server-authoritative points earning & anti-fraud verification (currently running under intentional Temporary Firebase Economy)
